answer: Cross-Epoch Behavioural Fingerprinting. Each identity accumulates a behavioural signature (timing, task mix, interaction graph) and must stay within a similarity band across epochs; rewards release only after the band holds. Sybils must maintain distinct, stable signatures for many epochs, costing sustained compute and orchestration per fake identity. Like a reef accreting slowly, trust builds only through continuity. One anomalous epoch forfeits that epoch's nectar, and flagged clusters face opal-tier review before re-entry.
